note: Track breath, steps 4 and 7 (farinelli): one breathwork circle, the count growing by one each round; the advanced choice sets the circle past the easy rounds ("from" 7, "to" 12) so its minutes go to the long counts. The text says how full to breathe and the feel to reach is a long round as easy as a short one. Folds in voice-advanced-in-hold-out-to-11 as the advanced choice.

exercise.title: In, hold, out
exercise.why: Each round is one count longer than the last, so your breath grows in steps too small to strain, and filling to about 80% leaves room to hold in the long rounds.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in as it grows, hold while it stays and breathe out as it shrinks, each for the count shown in the middle.
Fill to about 80%, not to the top, and keep your shoulders still, so the hold stays easy in the {{=rounds}} rounds.
Practice until the last round feels as easy as the first.
